verdict.rationale: Linear documents a public GraphQL API that it also uses internally. Its first-party docs cover personal API keys and OAuth2 with PKCE, schema introspection with a published SDL, a no-login Apollo Studio explorer, a typed TypeScript SDK, published rate limits and a deprecation policy, with worked query and mutation examples. Independent users report building CI and triage tooling on the GraphQL API, which corroborates hands-on use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Linear's public API is built using GraphQL. It's the same API we use internally for developing our applications.
The Linear API supports personal API keys and OAuth2 authentication.
It supports introspection so you can query the whole schema.
Our GraphQL API is explorable and queryable via [Apollo Studio](https://studio.apollographql.com/public/Linear-API/variant/current/home), no download or log in required.
The Linear Typescript SDK exposes the Linear GraphQL schema through strongly typed models and operations.
its GraphQL API and webhooks keep them happy
